entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You really got to show off your skills[n]in this Palace, didn't you, Futaba?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah, cracking this thing was a lot of[n]fun! Wish I could have gotten full[n]control, though.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Getting as far as you did was already[n]quite impressive.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I hate to admit it, but the rest of us[n]could never have done that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I hope we can rely on you for similar[n]tasks that may come up in the future.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Nothing to fear!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This super hacker has you covered!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, we were so cool in that casino...[n]Really got to run around like we owned[n]the place.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I would tell you not to let it go to your[n]head, but I'm in total agreement here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Casinos and phantom thieves go[n]together like cookies and milk!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I have to say... This is truly an[n]impressive slot machine.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The sheer scale of it is enough to stoke[n]the flames of creativity within me.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh... Even something like this can be[n]inspiring to you?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's complicated.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But as with all things in a Palace, this[n]machine was a product of the owner's[n]cognition. She willed it to exist as such.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I can't praise it in good conscience, but[n]I do believe there is something to be[n]gained from studying it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Come to think of it, you all must have[n]had a grand scheme to pull one over on[n]me before we even entered this Palace.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is true, but it did take an immense[n]effort to maintain the charade.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Deceiving someone for an extended[n]period of time is more exhausting than[n]I expected.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Is that so? Well, you stop feeling things[n]once you get used to it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I was so nervous when our leader got[n]arrested. I mean, I knew it was part of[n]our plan, but still.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Me too.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If any one thing went wrong, he could[n]have been killed. I was so scared...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It was quite a gamble. Literally.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heh... A perfect plan for phantom[n]thieves.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, I never doubted the guy. I knew[n]he'd pull through.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're exaggerating again...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm not! C'mon, the dude's our leader!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's no way he wasn't gonna make it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hehe... You have a point.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess even Ryuji says something good[n]once in a while.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whaddya mean "once in a while"!?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I can see the appeal of gambling...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I dunno about risking it all on a big one[n]like this, but I wouldn't mind giving a[n]smaller one a try.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ooh, Gambler NPC Mishima makes[n]his appearance!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: What kinda name is that? I sound like[n]a nobody!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Whoa there, what's this all about?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's a giant slot machine! Do you ever[n]like to gamble, Boss?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Eh, I dunno... Guess I buy lottery tickets[n]now and then, but that's about it.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Holy moly, that thing is ginormous.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Looks right up your alley. Are you going[n]to play?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Better not... I've got nothing but bad[n]memories with these things. Once I get[n]going, things go downhill quick...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's mature of you to realize that. Many[n]people fall prey to gambling addiction,[n]so good on you for knowing your limits.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Remember when this thing paid out the[n]big bucks? It felt sooo good!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right? Total jackpot! If only it wasn't[n]fake Palace money...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Technically, our leader's the one who[n]won it. And don't forget how I rigged[n]the thing!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, we'd never forget that!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey... Could you do that for us in the[n]real world too?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's illegal, Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I-I know that!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That whole Palace was a wild ride, but[n]the dark maze was something else.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It was pitch black in there, but there[n]were still so many Shadows...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is that what stood out to you? I wasn't[n]especially bothered by it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It was a novel experience to feel our[n]way through the darkness without our[n]sense of sight to guide us.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If that's how you feel, then just put on a[n]blindfold. You'll get all the inspiration in[n]the world.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ah, so by blocking my physical sight,[n]I can temper the mind's eye... Is that[n]what you mean?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sure. Let's go with that.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: *chuckle* This approach will surely[n]lead me to newfound beauty... I must[n]test it at once.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hoo boy, here he goes again.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You're free to, um, temper what you[n]will, but... Just don't get yourself in[n]trouble with the law, all right?
